title: Zcash $1000 ni kesib o‘tdi: shortlar $34,5 mln, ZCSH ETF
summary: ZEC ~$1023, 24s ~20%. ZCSH 25-avgustda NYSE Arca. Shielded 4,86 mln ZEC.
body:
4-sentabr ZEC $1000 ni kesib ~$1023. Hajm ~$1,2 mlrd, cap ~$16,9–17 mlrd. $36,6 mln likvidatsiya, $34,5 mln short. Shielded 4,86 mln ZEC (~28,8%).

Manba: CoinDesk, CoinGecko.

title: Waller stavkani ushlab turishga ochiq: BTC $82 ming
